decisions.reason: As a GIS solution platform close to the firm's core direction, it likely embodies substantial development effort and visible strategic commitment, which makes management inclined to continue backing it unless failure is unmistakable.

Mobile field data capture fits the firm's integrated geospatial offering well, and prior public promotion plus invested R&D make management likely to interpret any weaker traction as temporary rather than a reason to exit.

Although more modular and therefore somewhat easier to discontinue, the product was still being versioned and promoted after launch, so sunk effort, customer-facing commitment, and adjacency to the core web-mapping business support retaining it for now.
